info.title: APAAR Student Data & Verification Platform (SIH26263 prototype)
info.description: Prototype. APAAR registry, AICTE approval registry, OTP and identity provider are MOCKS. Synthetic data only.

post.description: MOCK student sign-in: APAAR ID + date of birth. Production: APAAR/DigiLocker authentication. 5 failed attempts per APAAR in 15 minutes lock it out.
CSV (multipart field 'file' or text/csv body) or JSON {rows:[...]}. Validation runs synchronously.

get.description: Empty upload template: the header row of the data dictionary.
Institution: own enrolments. University registrar: its affiliated institutions' enrolments (RLS). Lookup by APAAR or institution student id.

schema.title: Response Find Enrolments V1 Enrolments Get
Response Ledger Checkpoint V1 Ledger Checkpoints Post

get.description: Public: latest signed checkpoint, plus the AICTE ledger public key.
Explainable anomaly flags with evidence (risk indicators for review, not proof of misconduct).
Institutions ranked by risk = (100 - DQS) x active enrolments, with DQS components and reasons.

schema.title: Response Inspection Queue V1 Inspection Queue Get

get.description: The calling institution's own Data Quality Score and flags.
Available reports for the caller's role.
CSV report (formula-injection safe). Institutions: accreditation and category-utilisation for their own data. Regulators: all reports; accreditation needs ?institution_id=.
Institutions: cases touching their own enrolments, neutral text, own enrolment ids only. Regulators: all.

schema.title: Response List Cases V1 Cases Get

post.description: AICTE officer. confirmed_duplicate revokes the credentials of every enrolment except keep_enrolment_id; under_investigation suspends them. Audited; visible to the student (D6).
AICTE officer: both sides of a case in clear. The reason is audited and shown to the student (D6).
EnrolmentCredential: the student's institution. DegreeCredential (completed enrolments): the affiliated university registrar. Accepts Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Credentials visible to the caller (issuer, subject student or regulator), optionally for one enrolment.

schema.title: Response List Credentials V1 Credentials Get

get.description: Printable certificate data (Req 10): the VC plus its offline QR ('AV1:' + Base45(zlib(VC))) as SVG.

post.description: Issuer revokes/suspends (or un-suspends) one of its own credentials via the Bitstring Status List.
Online verification helper. The same checks can be run offline with the signed registry snapshot and status lists.

schema.title: Response Registry Issuers V1 Registry Issuers Get

get.description: Public: AICTE-signed registry snapshot for offline verifiers, plus the AICTE key.
DEMO ONLY: a credential signed by an issuer outside the registry.

post.description: Verifier asks a student (by APAAR ID) to share specific fields for a stated purpose. The response is the same whether or not the APAAR is registered; rate-limited (20/hour per verifier) and audit-logged.

get.description: Verifier: its own requests. Student: requests about them. Regulators: all.

schema.title: Response Consent List V1 Consents Get

post.description: Student (or guardian, if under 18) approves with the MOCK OTP; mints the scoped VerificationCredential.
Student withdraws consent; the VerificationCredential is revoked via the status list.

get.description: Verifier fetches the VerificationCredential for its granted consent.
D6 transparency: every recorded access to the student's data (reads, exports, verifications, consents).
